HINDRANCES

AILIN' (MINOR): You picked up some kind of illness from one of your patients. You subtract 1 from rolls made to resist Fatigue from any source. A Critical Failure means your illness escalates to the Major version (see Deadlands).

HEAVY SLEEPER (MINOR): You sleep deep and hard, subtracting 4 from Notice rolls to wake you and -4 from Vigor rolls made to stay awake.

HEROIC (MAJOR): You never turn down those in need.

EDGES

GALLOWS HUMOR: You can use your Taunt instead of your Spirit when making Fear tests. With a raise, you add +1 to all your ally's Fear tests (so make sure you roll first!).

HEALER: You have a knack for taking care of folks. Add +2 to Healing rolls.

HUMILIATE: You can reroll Taunt (and yes, that applies to Taunt used to resist Fear per your Gallows Humor Edge).

RABBLE-ROUSER: As a limited action, make a social Test with Intimidation or Taunt against all enemies in a Medium Blast Template. Each defender resists and is affected by the Test separately.

GEAR

Doctor's bag, Colt Army (Range 12/24/48, Damage 2d6+1, AP 1, RoF 1, Shots 6), .44 ammo (×50), knife (Str+d4), 2× dehydrated air tablet (10 minutes air when placed in mouth), one dose of liquid courage (+2 to Fear checks for 30 minutes), 2× tactile desensitizer (reduce Wound penalties by 2 for 10 minutes), $45.

Shooting d6 and Stealth d6, Spirit d8, Healing d8 and Taunt d8, Humiliate, Rabble-Rouser.
